description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

As a Senior District Manager, you will lead a high-performing team of Enterprise Account Executives managing some of Snowflake’s most strategic accounts in Germany. Partnering closely with cross-functional teams, you will coach and empower your team to drive new workload adoption and accelerate consumption growth across these key businesses.

AS A SENIOR DISTRICT MANAGER, YOU WILL:

  • Hire, enable, coach, develop and motivate a high-performing field sales team

  • Have an in-depth understanding of Snowflake's products in order to guide your team on selling, navigating complex negotiations, eliminating technical barriers and managing escalations

  • Develop your territory by planning effectively, designing account coverage and assigning accounts across your team

  • Coach your team on account planning for each customer, including C-level engagement, multi-year growth plans

  • Ensure customers are set up for success and are consuming Snowflake effectively

  • Manage weekly forecast meetings with the EMEA leadership team, providing accurate pipeline and consumption insights

  • Ensure the success of events by collaborating with marketing and being accountable for attendance

  • Coach your team on working with in-region partner network to grow Snowflake within their accounts

AS A SENIOR DISTRICT MANAGER, YOU WILL HAVE:

  • BA/BS or equivalent professional experience

  • 10+ years of field sales experience with an emphasis on data or cloud related technology

  • Proven ability to manage and develop teams that close large, multi-year contracts with strategic enterprise customers

  • A track record of hiring, developing and keeping top sales talent

  • Experience with a structured sales methodology such as MEDDPICC or similar

  • A proactive mindset with high energy and a positive attitude

  • The ability to think strategically and understand the "bigger picture" along with the business drivers around it

  • Fluency in German and English

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com
